note: Local development only. The published model is built by training/configs/fcos-dense-v3.json and replaced here after its release; this entry points at the first two-epoch run so the loading path, the overlay and the counts can be exercised before then. That export skipped the in-graph normalisation and decoded anchor centres half a cell off, which is what the preprocessing flags correct. Dynamic INT8 does not run correctly on WebGPU in onnxruntime-web 1.31.1 (1000 capped boxes for a 690-item shelf, versus 481 on WASM), so quantised files set webgpu_capable=false and the loader goes straight to WASM.
precision: int8 (dynamic quantisation of the FP32 export)
validation_split: CC0 Supermarket Shelves validation, 9 images, 1922 items
